steps.title: Same query, four answers
steps.body: Alice, Bob, Charlie and Diana each ran the identical query. No WHERE clause in this app anywhere — the rule that shapes each panel lives on the entity, not in this code.

steps.title: Raw SQL respects it too
steps.body: This bar runs the exact same SELECT count(*) FROM {project_task} per user. Most backends leak analytics via a service role; here even hand-written SQL stays inside the guard — a bare table name with no braces is refused, not run unguarded.

steps.title: One artifact, security on or off
steps.body: Click this and watch the panels converge — the same dataset redeployed with rls.enabled stripped. Click again and they diverge. Nothing else about the app changed.

steps.title: Live writes, live guards
steps.body: Advance a task and only the panels whose user may see it will repaint. Try it — the tour moves on once the grid updates.

steps.title: This is the guard, in the model
steps.body: The modeler, loaded from a CDN script tag with no build step. Project Task carries the RLS guard that just did all of this — open the entity to see who may read, write and delete.

steps.title: Every read, audited
steps.body: Four reads under four different principals, through one BFF token. Same published component you'd drop into your own app.
